If you're reading this, something has happened to me and you need to look after the computers and services in this house. This packet is the map: what's running, where it is, how to get in, and what you can safely ignore.

What matters most

  1. Photos and documents are on the file server (see "Getting into the file server"). Copy them somewhere safe first.
  2. The internet comes through the router. If it stops working, restart the router before anything else.
  3. Everything else can be switched off or replaced without losing anything important.

Who can help

A friend who knows this setup: Alex Example, alex@example.com.

How this packet is organised

The pages first, then the appendices: every device on the network (Appendix A) and every password (Appendix B).
